title: M3E Canvas: a Material 3 mockup tool that writes the coding prompt for you when you're done

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Describing a UI to an AI coding assistant in plain English is always worse than just drawing it. M3 Canvas lets you drag and drop material 3. Expressive components, buttons, fabs, navbars, cards, wire up the screens with tap through navigation. Then it writes the coding prompt for you in English or Japanese with behavioral notes per component. Components snap together magnetically. Full undo and redo. PNG export. No backend. Everything lives in local
